name: @dr-w/mcp-toolkit
description: Developer-first toolkit for inspecting, debugging, and securing MCP servers.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @dr-w/inspector-runtime && npm run build --workspace @dr-w/inspector-web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @dr-w/core && npm run build --workspace @dr-w/mcp-client && npm run build --workspace @dr-w/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run typecheck --workspace @dr-w/inspector-runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @dr-w/inspector-web
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck --workspace @dr-w/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @dr-w/mcp-client && npm run typecheck --workspace @dr-w/ui
